wages.text: Benitez-Thompson stated that everyone should be allowed to organize and indicated support for federal legislation repealing right-to-work laws.
wages.quote: She indicated she would support repealing right to work laws through federal legislation.

trade.text: She says tariffs have raised consumer costs and trapped the country in costly trade wars.
trade.quote: The cost of groceries and household goods have increased. Families, small businesses and Nevada's tourist-based economy are feeling the negative effects and trying to figure out ways to absorb the extra cost. We are caught in costly trade wars with no relief in sight.

housing.text: Her economic plan calls for building workforce housing that ordinary Nevadans can afford.
housing.quote: I am running on an integrated plan: restore hundreds of millions of tax dollars stripped from Nevada by Elon Musk and DOGE; develop strong regulations to prevent massive job layoffs due to AI; and build workforce housing that everyday Nevandans can afford.

immigration.text: She opposes mass deportation and calls for fair, efficient immigration reform with humane enforcement.
immigration.quote: This is not how the country should carry on, with families being torn apart, and the legal process being undermined. Tackling immigration policy is a priority for me, and honestly, both parties have gotten it wrong. We are long overdue for fair and efficient reform with humane enforcement.

abortion.text: She supports federal legislation protecting reproductive freedom.
abortion.quote: That means defending the Affordable Care Act, ensuring Medicaid covers mental and behavioral health issues, and protecting reproductive freedom through federal legislation.

health.text: She supports the Affordable Care Act and Medicaid and says she voted to establish Nevada’s public-option health plan.
health.quote: I voted to create public-option healthcare program, which covers 10,000 people through the Battle Born State Plan; made sure you can’t be charged out of pocket cost for contraception and extended the period of time you can get a prescription for contraception; voted for measures to address Nevada’s high maternal mortality rates; and voted for a package of legislation to create transparency in drug pricing.

voting.text: She opposes the SAVE Act and supports expanded mail and early voting, automatic registration, and same-day registration.
voting.quote: That means opposing the SAVE Act and every other effort to institute onerous barriers to voter registration. It means expanding, not restricting, mail voting and early voting.

tax.text: Flippo promises federal tax cuts and opposes raising federal tax rates.
tax.quote: Deliver tax cuts that put money back in your pocket.

trade.text: Flippo described tariffs as a tool for countering unfair international economic practices and creating a fairer marketplace.
trade.quote: Tariffs have been a tool to bring other countries into line to build a fair global marketplace.

debt.text: Flippo opposes raising the Social Security retirement age and supports protecting benefits from taxation.
debt.quote: “We should not raise the retirement age,” Flippo wrote before referencing a new tax break in last year's One Big Beautiful Bill Act . “We should protect no tax on Social Security!”

housing.text: Flippo supports transferring federal land to Nevada to increase the housing supply.
housing.quote: Flippo said he supports the majority of the lands bills and will work with the governor to return federal land to the state to help create more housing supply.

schools.text: Flippo supports school choice and directing education funding according to students' enrollment choices.
schools.quote: I am an advocate for school choice where the money follows the child.

safety.text: Flippo supports tougher sentencing for violent and repeat offenders.
safety.quote: Enact tough sentencing for violent and repeat offenders.

immigration.text: Flippo supports deportations, ending catch-and-release, and ending sanctuary policies.
immigration.quote: Deport illegal aliens. Americans do not reward people for breaking our laws.

guns.text: Flippo says no additional gun restrictions are needed and that some existing gun laws should be repealed.
guns.quote: None. Law-abiding Americans should face no additional restrictions, and many current gun laws that burden responsible citizens should be repealed.

abortion.text: Flippo supports allowing abortion only in very narrow circumstances, principally to save the mother's life and possibly in cases of rape or incest.
abortion.quote: Abortion should be allowed only in the narrowest possible circumstances, principally to save the life of the mother, and perhaps in cases of rape or incest.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Flippo supports excluding transgender women and girls from female sports, locker rooms, and restrooms.
gender.quote: Men do not belong in girls’ sports, locker rooms, or restrooms.

health.text: Flippo opposes reinstating Affordable Care Act premium subsidies and has called the law a disaster.
health.quote: Obamacare was a disaster for the American people, specifically Nevadans

energy.text: Flippo supports expanding domestic energy production to reduce gasoline and electricity prices.
energy.quote: Unleash American energy production to lower gas and electricity bills.

voting.text: Flippo supports the SAVE Act, voter identification, and proof-of-citizenship requirements.
voting.quote: Pass the SAVE Act. The overwhelming majority of Americans agree that voter ID and proof of citizenship is a must.

tax.text: Chapman opposed raising property taxes and argued that Nevada should not overtax residents.
tax.quote: This is the wrong time to even consider raising taxes on families and raising property taxes.

guns.text: Chapman opposed legislation restricting firearms at certain businesses and argued that additional laws targeting lawful gun owners were not the answer.
guns.quote: More laws like this targeting legal gun owners is not the answer. Please oppose Senate Bill 452.

abortion.text: Chapman criticized a resolution supporting Roe and Casey, saying it protected women's abortion rights without protecting children's rights.
abortion.quote: I am very saddened that a child's rights are never protected.
